our_interpretation: Treat this as a qualified numerical forecast rather than a condition dependent on a separate event.
Read the four-year period as May 19, 2026 through May 19, 2030, following 'the next four years' in the preceding paragraph.
Read operating expenses as additional non-compute operating costs, because the preceding tally already counts compute commitments.
The context concerns money Anthropic must make or raise. Any use of accounting expenses must therefore reconcile noncash charges and avoid double-counting compute.
Do not substitute four times a current annual run rate for actual cumulative expenses.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish at least $20 billion of additional non-compute operating costs attributable to the specified four-year period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Complete records for the four-year period establish less than $20 billion on the same scope and basis.
